evidence.field_locator: §4.1 NFF ELITESERIEN – SERIESPILLET: 'Klubbene skal spille mot hverandre to ganger, en kamp på hjemmebane og en kamp på bortebane.' (§4.2: 15th/16th relegated, 14th playoff; §4.3: kickoff times set by NFF/NTF/rights holder, final round simultaneous)

evidence.field_locator: NFF 2024 final table: 16 teams, S (matches played) = 30 for all; rounds numbered 1-30 on fixture page
NFF 2023 final table: 16 teams, S=30 for all 16

federation_format_evidence.format: 16 teams, double round robin (each pair meets twice: once home, once away), 30 rounds, 240 matches per season. Season runs March to November/early December.
federation_format_evidence.meeting_number_note: NFF regulations mandate each pair meets twice (home+away) but the fixture table does not label which leg a fixture is. meeting_number is NOT directly sourced; per hard rule it is returned as unresolved, not derived.
federation_format_evidence.season_format_note: 16-team format since 2009 (first 16-team top flight since 1961-62 Hovedserien per en.wikipedia 2009 Tippeligaen). 14 teams 1995-2008. League named Tippeligaen 1990/1991-2016, Eliteserien from 2017.
